title: HaaS: Make Agent Execution a Service
titleZh: HaaS：把 Agent 执行变成服务

title: An agent that works.
A service you can trust?
scenes.subtitle: 能执行任务，不等于能被产品稳定使用。
cues: An agent can complete a task.
一个 Agent 可以完成任务。
But turning that agent into a dependable product is a different problem.
但把它做成可靠的产品，是另一回事。
Each runtime brings its own sessions, tools, permissions, event stream, and recovery rules.
每种 runtime 都有自己的会话、工具、权限、事件流和恢复规则。
Your application ends up owning all those differences.
这些差异，最终都落到你的应用身上。
Switching runtimes means rebuilding the integration, not just changing a model name.
切换 runtime，意味着重做接入，而不仅是换一个模型名。

title: The runtime.
Not just the model.
scenes.subtitle: 统一完整 Agent Runtime 的服务边界，不重造执行引擎。
cues: HaaS stands for Harness as a Service.
HaaS 是 Harness as a Service 的缩写。
A harness is the complete agent runtime.
Harness 是完整的 Agent Runtime。
It reasons, uses tools, edits files, and maintains a session.
它负责推理、使用工具、修改文件和维护会话。
HaaS puts a stable service boundary around that runtime.
HaaS 为这个 runtime 建立稳定的服务边界。
It is not another model API, and it does not replace the agent's execution engine.
它不是又一个模型 API，也不替代 Agent 自己的执行引擎。

title: One contract.
Clear responsibilities.
scenes.subtitle: 应用负责产品，HaaS 管理执行，Harness 提供原生能力。
cues: Your application or Manager calls an ADK-compatible web API with live event streaming.
应用或 Manager 调用兼容 ADK、支持实时事件流的 Web API。
The HaaS control sidecar manages sessions, execution records, policies, and events.
HaaS 控制 sidecar 管理会话、执行记录、策略和事件。
Adapters keep native harness protocols out of your application.
Adapter 把 harness 原生协议隔离在应用之外。
The security design keeps provider credentials behind trusted proxies.
安全设计把 provider 凭据保留在可信代理之后。
The runtime receives only scoped access.
Runtime 仅获得限定范围的访问能力。
Codex app-server is the first implemented adapter.
Codex app-server 是首个已实现的 adapter。

title: A request is not a result.
Follow the whole lifecycle.
scenes.subtitle: 发现 → 提交 → 事件流 → 明确终态 → 结果回读
cues: Follow one execution.
看一次执行。
The client discovers a configured harness, then submits a task through the run endpoint.
客户端先发现已配置的 harness，再通过执行端点提交任务。
HaaS checks identity and policy before handing work to the adapter.
HaaS 在把工作交给 adapter 前检查身份和策略。
As the runtime works, its output becomes canonical events, then the application's live stream.
Runtime 的输出先成为 canonical event，再进入应用的实时流。
The execution finishes with an explicit terminal state.
执行以明确的终态结束。
The client can read back the recorded result.
客户端可以回读已记录的结果。
There is no need to guess whether the stream meant success.
不必猜测流结束是否意味着成功。

title: A dropped connection
is not a cancelled task.
scenes.subtitle: 把请求连接和执行事实分开，失败仍需明确呈现。
cues: This lifecycle is where service integration gets difficult.
服务接入的难点，就在这里。
A retry should not start the same work twice.
重试，不应该重复启动同一份工作。
Two turns should not write through the same session at once.
两个 turn 不应该同时通过同一 session 写入。
Losing a streaming connection should not be confused with cancelling the task.
流式连接丢失，不应该被误认为任务取消。
HaaS uses idempotency, session leases, and event replay to address those cases.
HaaS 用幂等、会话租约和事件回放处理这些情况。
Recovery still depends on the runtime and retained state. Failure must remain explicit.
恢复仍取决于 runtime 和保留状态。失败必须明确呈现。

title: Same service boundary.
Explicit runtime choices.
scenes.subtitle: 本地 sidecar、远端端点与容器执行，不是同一种隔离承诺。
cues: The same service boundary separates the product from where execution runs.
同一个服务边界，把产品与执行位置分开。
The desktop design uses a local managed sidecar.
桌面设计使用本地托管 sidecar。
Remote endpoints and delegated containers are explicit alternatives.
远端端点和委托容器是显式替代方案。
Local does not automatically mean container-isolated.
本地执行，不自动意味着容器隔离。
Lite targets minimal container execution; AIO adds the desktop and browser environment.
Lite 面向最小容器执行；AIO 增加桌面与浏览器环境。
Those are different runtime choices, not interchangeable security guarantees.
它们是不同运行方式，不是可互换的安全承诺。
Codex is implemented first. Pi, OpenCode, and AMP are planned.
Codex 首先实现；Pi、OpenCode 和 AMP 仍在规划中。
Code in the repository is not the same as a verified release.
仓库里有代码，不等于已经完成发布验证。

scenes.chapter: THE PRODUCT YOU GET TO BUILD
title: Build the product.
Not every runtime integration.
scenes.subtitle: 把精力留给产品，而不是反复对接每一种 Agent Runtime。
cues: The goal is not to build one more agent.
目标不是再造一个 Agent。
It is to stop every product from rebuilding the machinery around every agent.
而是让每个产品，不必为每种 Agent 重做外围执行基础设施。
A stable integration boundary. Execution you can track. Permissions you can reason about.
稳定的接入边界，可以追踪的执行过程，能够理解的权限规则。
Start with the available Codex adapter and check its documented capability boundaries.
从现有 Codex adapter 开始，核对文档中的能力边界。
Build your product against the HaaS service contract.
面向 HaaS 服务合同，构建你的产品。
Make agent execution a service. Keep your focus on the product.
把 Agent 执行变成服务，把精力留给真正的产品。
Explore the code and documentation on GitHub. Find HaaS under Superops Team.
在 GitHub 上探索代码与文档：Superops Team 的 HaaS 仓库。
